column3: Description EN
The residential sector provides accommodation for T1 Humans. Each level increases the living space and growth rate on the planet.
With each level, the expansion of the Biosphere Farm increases the storage capacity and amount of food produced per second.
The Research Centre unlocks the tech tree for Humans, and the costs and duration of research of new technologies decrease with each level.
At the Academy, T1 Humans are trained up into T2 Humans. Each level increases the number of trained individuals.
T2 Humans are trained up into T3 Humans in the Neuro-Calibration Centre. Each level increases the number of trained individuals.
High Energy Smelting increases the planet’s metal production with each level.

The Food Silo makes it possible to distribute food more efficiently. Each level increases the maximum amount of food, reduces the food consumption of T1 Humans on this planet and increases the speed at which the number of T1, T2 and T3 Humans increases.
Fusion-Powered Production increases crystal and deuterium production on the planet with each level.
The Skyscraper provides accommodation for numerous individuals. Each level increases the maximum number of Humans on the planet and the speed at which the number of T1, T2 and T3 Humans increases.
The Biotech Lab increases the planet’s food production with each level.
The Metropolis improves all technologies on this planet.
The Planetary Shield protects some of the people on the planet in the event of an attack. The number of people protected increases with each level.

Intergalactic Envoys are capable of detecting extra-terrestrial civilisations. They also reduced the duration of exploration flights to detect other lifeforms in the Galaxy view with each level. However, exploration is not without danger, and ships are occasionally lost in the endeavour.
High-Performance Extractors increase the production of metal, crystals and deuterium on all planets with each level.
This advancement in drive technology makes civilian ships faster.  Each level increases the speed.
Stealth Field Generators reduce the costs and duration of researching spy tech.
A portion of the resource supplies will be stored here safe from plundering. The den increases the storage capacity.
The Research AI allows research projects to be completed much faster. Each level increases the speed of research.
The High-Performance Terraformer reduces the costs, energy required and duration of building the terraformer with each level.
Enhanced Production Technologies increase the production of metal, crystals and deuterium on all planets with each level.

The Automatised Assembly Centre reduces the construction time of ships.
Each level of the High-Performance Transformer increases energy production on the planet as well as the technology bonus.
Improved microchips allow the Mechas to be more efficient. Each level increases food production on the planet and increases the speed at which the number of T1, T2 and T3 Mechas increases.

New Mechas can now be assembled even faster in the production assembly hall. Each level increases the maximum number of Mechas on the planet and the speed at which the number of T1, T2 and T3 Mechas increases.
